runtimeContract: Opcode 53 replaces the tracked set by exact caste or an authored caste group, with Castle's clear-before-mode-two behavior producing an empty set. Opcode 55 tests any pick, one documented party position, or at least the magnitude of a negative selector. Unsupported positive selectors safely fail. Success branches to the authored XAP; failure exits, follows the documented failure XAP, or publishes the authored message and exits.
correction: Castle aliases selectors 1 through 6 to party slot zero, compares other magnitudes for exact equality, and overwrites the documented failure XAP with its exit sentinel. Realmz 2.0 retains the authoring contract: one-based positions, negative at-least thresholds, and a usable failure branch.
determinism: Both operations use stable party order and consume no RNG.
